verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party retention or deletion controls, such as configurable retention periods, log or backup retention settings, or documented purge or delete workflows. What exists is adjacent only: Supabase Cron can run SQL on a schedule, which a developer could use to build retention jobs, and self-hosting offers general 'full control over your data'. Backups are retained for fixed per-plan windows, and GDPR support covers residency and a DPA, not deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
